title: Plan limits and a usage page
summary: Plan limits and a usage page, organization analytics, export to any shape, multi-language zip downloads and a live Cosmos assistant.

sections.title: Plan limits and usage
sections.note: Every plan has seat and storage limits, shown on **Settings → Usage**.

items.body: Uploads that won't fit are stopped before they start
Upgrades take effect once paid, with no refresh

sections.title: Organization analytics
sections.note: Parent organizations get an Analytics page across all their organizations.

items.body: Build your own dashboard from widgets and templates
Export to any shape, with **Fit** or **Fill** and crop
Multi-language exports download as one zip
Cosmos: the workflow assistant replies live and handles branches
Translation Memory: redesigned pages and a provider filter
4:5 exports no longer squeeze portrait videos
Exports retry instead of dropping burned-in subtitles
Two quick edits on the same video no longer overwrite each other
A paid upgrade is always recorded, and never charged twice
